title: •Rapid Deployment
caption: •Rapid Deployment (V)
game_text: Target a site. At same and related sites, Rebel scouts deploying from hand are deploy -2 (and they may not battle or move) for remainder of turn. OR ▼ a Rebel scout (deploy +2) to a site.
lore: General Solo’s strike team was made up of the Alliance’s finest ground troops.
